def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    walls = [(r, g[r][0]) for r in range(h) if g[r][0] != 0 and all(v == g[r][0] for v in g[r])]
    if not walls:
        return g
    wall_r, wall_color = walls[0]
    dr = 1 if wall_r < h // 2 else -1
    wall_cells = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == wall_color}
    seen = set()
    pieces = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = g[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in wall_cells or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    q = (y+dy, x+dx)
                    if 0 <= q[0] < h and 0 <= q[1] < w and q not in seen and g[q[0]][q[1]] == color:
                        seen.add(q)
                        stack.append(q)
            pieces.append(cells)
    if dr == 1:
        pieces.sort(key=lambda cells: -max(r for r,c in cells))
    else:
        pieces.sort(key=lambda cells: min(r for r,c in cells))
    settled = set(wall_cells)
    for cells in pieces:
        color = grid[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
        shape = set(cells)
        while True:
            shifted = {(y+dr, x) for y,x in shape}
            if any(y < 0 or y >= h or (y,x) in settled for y,x in shifted):
                break
            shape = shifted
        for y,x in shape:
            g[y][x] = color
            settled.add((y,x))
    return g
PY
